promises.quote: The Trust has now received management guidelines from the Renal Team at UHCW and below is a table showing what actions the Trust has taken to embed the information received. Description Action Taken New guidelines to be made easily Guidelines have been developed and are currently accessible on the Trust's intranet going through the Trust's ratification process prior to uploading on to the Trust's intranet.
promises.summary: Develop and disseminate renal management guidelines via intranet and posters

promises.quote: these guidelines have been finalised and agreed between the Trusts and we enclose a copy.
promises.summary: Finalised renal guidelines shared with GEH to improve care coordination.

promises.quote: We recommend that all hospital switchboards, Emergency Departments and relevant personnel have a master copy of local specialist centre contact details so any query at any time can be appropriately directed.
promises.summary: Provide master contact list for specialist centres to all switchboards and EDs.

promises.quote: We recommend that all staff are advised of internal escalation routes. Relevant clinical colleagues should be aware of internal escalation routes to clarify whether off-site specialist input is required. We would expect this to be achieved by asking the Consultant responsible for the patient's care or their deputy.
promises.summary: Advise staff of internal escalation routes via responsible consultant.

promises.quote: We advise that electronic information sharing in real-time should be the gold standard for information sharing. In the case of kidney patients, we would expect to be informed about all patients admitted for care in another hospital or elsewhere in our own hospital who have chronic kidney disease stage 5 (CKD G5) or who are receiving dialysis treatment or who have a kidney transplant.
promises.summary: Implement real-time electronic sharing of CKD G5, dialysis, transplant patients.

promises.quote: We confirm that staff at UHCW are aware of internal escalation routes. The escalation of concerns is via the renal registrar and renal consultant. We confirm that UHCW has shared and agreed with George Eliot Hospitals the indications for referral to us as a specialist unit, and the routes for referral.
promises.summary: Confirm internal escalation routes and referral agreements with partner hospitals.

promises.quote: Electronic patient sharing of blood test results in real-time exists for patients who are already known to UHCW Renal Department, whether admitted to GEH or SWFT. In addition,
promises.summary: Share blood test results in real-time for known renal patients.

promises.quote: Turnaround times for all pathology labs are published in CWPS Handbook V16 May 2024.pdf.
promises.summary: Publish pathology turnaround times in handbook.

promises.summary: Provide master contact list for specialist centres to all hospital switchboards and EDs.
